Project Nayuki QR Code generator, C++ implementation, release v1.8.0.

Upstream: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/v1.8.0/cpp
License: MIT; the complete copyright and license notices are retained in both files.
The upstream sources are unmodified. Requires C++11 and the standard library only.

Used for server-side SVG generation. Android retains its existing ZXing encoder;
Android and iOS do not need to compile these files or prayer-sharing.cpp.
